mapper.select: SELECT m.match_id AS matchId ,f.name AS facilityName ,m.title AS title ,m.start_at AS startAt FROM social_match m JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = m.facility_id JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = m.facility_id WHERE fm.user_id = #{managerUserId} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.status = #{matchStatus} ORDER BY m.start_at DESC, m.match_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.match_id AS matchId ,f.name AS facilityName ,m.title AS title ,m.start_at AS startAt FROM social_match m JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = m.facility_id JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = m.facility_id WHERE fm.user_id = #{managerUserId} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.status = #{matchStatus} AND m.match_id = #{matchId}
SELECT m.match_id AS matchId ,m.facility_id AS facilityId ,m.status AS status FROM social_match m WHERE m.match_id = #{matchId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.user_id AS userId ,u.nickname AS nickname FROM match_participant p JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE p.match_id = #{matchId} AND p.participation_status = #{participationStatus} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.nickname ORDER BY u.nickname ASC, u.user_id ASC
SELECT report_id FROM report WHERE report_id = #{reportId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report ( reporter_user_id, target_user_id, match_id, reviewed_by, category, summary, status, resolution, created_at, reviewed_at ) VALUES ( #{reporterUserId}, #{targetUserId}, #{matchId}, NULL, #{category}, #{summary}, #{status}, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id AS reportId ,r.match_id AS matchId ,f.name AS facilityName ,m.title AS matchTitle ,target.nickname AS targetName ,r.category AS category ,r.status AS status ,r.created_at AS createdAt ,r.resolution AS resolution FROM report r JOIN social_match m ON m.match_id = r.match_id JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = m.facility_id JOIN app_user target ON target.user_id = r.target_user_id JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = m.facility_id WHERE r.reporter_user_id = #{reporterUserId} AND fm.user_id = #{managerUserId} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.report_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.report_id AS reportId ,r.match_id AS matchId ,f.name AS facilityName ,m.title AS matchTitle ,target.nickname AS targetName ,r.category AS category ,r.status AS status ,r.created_at AS createdAt ,r.summary AS summary ,r.resolution AS resolution FROM report r JOIN social_match m ON m.match_id = r.match_id JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = m.facility_id JOIN app_user target ON target.user_id = r.target_user_id JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = m.facility_id WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId} AND r.reporter_user_id = #{reporterUserId} AND fm.user_id = #{managerUserId} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT r.report_id AS reportId ,r.match_id AS matchId ,f.name AS facilityName ,m.title AS matchTitle ,target.nickname AS targetName ,reporter.nickname AS reporterName ,r.category AS category ,r.status AS status ,r.created_at AS createdAt ,r.summary AS summary ,r.resolution AS resolution FROM report r LEFT JOIN social_match m ON m.match_id = r.match_id LEFT JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = m.facility_id LEFT JOIN app_user target ON target.user_id = r.target_user_id LEFT JOIN app_user reporter ON reporter.user_id = r.reporter_user_id WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId}

SELECT r.report_id AS reportId ,r.reporter_user_id AS reporterUserId ,r.target_user_id AS targetUserId ,r.match_id AS matchId ,r.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy ,r.category AS category ,r.summary AS summary ,r.status AS status ,r.resolution AS resolution ,r.created_at AS createdAt ,r.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt FROM report r WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET status = #{targetStatus}, resolution = #{resolution}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND status IN ('접수', '검토 중')
